## What is Deathbringer?
- **D**eath**B**ringer (DB) is the Master class of Blood Berserker (BB)
- Beginner -> Warrior -> Barbarian -> Blood Berserker -> Death Bringer

**Wraith Form Talent**
- A lot more later on, but basics:
- You will have a togglable talent "Wraith Form" which feels like a new account, as nearly no external account bonuses will work. See more at ⚠️ (link)
- - Your stats will be low, you'll struggle in W1, level the stats with bones and slowly progress. You can toggle out of it any point to be yourself again. (~5 second cooldown)

- You collect Bones, to upgrade your stats on DB, to push further for more bones. 
- You can invest Bones for various external benefits, see wiki <https://idleon.wiki/wiki/Death_Bringer>

## How to get Talent points for Deathbringer

- Alchemy does NOT give Talent points to Tab 5!

**Talents Points: **
- 3 Talent Points every Class level above 250 (including 250)
- 50 Flurbos from Dungeon
- 100 W6 Merit Shop (+5 per level)
- 1 Talent point per every 5th Level per individual skill from W1-W3 skills
- Further into Grimoire there's some unlocks that give more talent points for DB
```(level - 249) * 3 + flurbo + 5 * merit + Sum(floor(skillLevel / 5), for each w1-w3 skill)``` by <@146038451790282753> I believe <:Hearto:812252292597547018> 

For the Skill levels, this means if woodcutting is level 9, you get 1 point (because level 5) If you have woodcutting and mining level 9 each thats only 2 points, you do NOT add the skills up together, its per individual skill.




## **Leveling your Deathbringer**  ⚠️ 
If you want to level Deathbringer for more Talent Points, the main things that matter are:
- GT, GT and more GT (Alchemy: Grind Time Bubble for +% Class XP)
- Chocolate chip (For crystals, they give 30x The XP)
- Hole Class XP can be a bunch but a terrible priority (Justice Monument)
- Active XP is way better than Offline.
- Various small things that you should know, aka star signs active XP, card sets, card, gold food, chips etc.

# AFK ON DB

## **NEW DB  AFK INFO** AS OF 4/29/2025
**How to unlock**
- DB somewhere to gain "Charred Fragments", you need 1000. These are only gained active.
- I did W5 Stilted moles and took ~1h 45min (without manual grave placements, ~90x DR if dr is relevant?)
- Use the 1000x Charred Fragements, Gz you unlocked AFK!
- Greenstacking "not possible" (unless you want to spend months and months)

**How to AFK?**
- You can now AFK in any combat area, even out of wraith form, even stuff like golems for statues or gmush.
- Every 1 hour of offline time on DB will give you 1x "Charred Bone" this works same as the WW time skips.
- Hours are rounded down, so 1h 59min = 1h = 1 bone   (Candies don't count as offline time)
- Each "charred bone" = 1h time skip for bones.
- NOTHING buffs this, 1h is 1h and gives you 1 bone, 10h is 10 bones.. No AFK% or anything. Candy doesn't work.

**How to use AFK bones**
- Maximize your best bones/h in wraith form, best to use an active spot from the image: https://discord.com/channels/437797104786604034/1330702925294735360/1330703216069054484
- Once you get to as high of a number as possible (typically towards the end of your grave) consume the charred bone!
- **WARNING**: The entire stack of Charred Bones is used! You can split your stack in storage though and just use how many you want.

## **Mob Order**
<a:siren_red:1325223183552483419> ⚠️ 
Work In Progress, may change at any time.

**Notes: To Remember:**
- Early On Survival is Hard, Equip Food + Efficiency Card Setup For Crit Talent.
- Different Mobs Different Bones ( Check On The Mobs Card ).
- Don't Forget to Even Out Upgrades to Unlock New Ones Faster, New upgrade = more upgrades = more Accuracy from Talent. But overall focus Accuracy more especially when you unlock Accuracy 2, once you're stuck at w3-4 area waiting for Accuracy 3.
- Don't Need 100% Accuracy To Move On, ~60%+ to 75%+ Is Good Enough (Test this and check bone/h).
- Graveyard placement is important and makes a huge difference on certain maps, some maps are better for actively manually replacing the grave, where others are better for afk (no input/manual placement). 
**- HORDE SPAWN 2 platforms above and under your graveyard, this is based on order of height, not walking order.**


**Why Graveyard Placement is Important:**
- Graveyard Spawns Hordes which increase your bones found when killed, they spawn anywhere horizontally up to 2 platforms above and under. By placing it on the specified position stated on Map Progression you force them to spawn closer to you = faster you kill them = more bones found within allocated skill duration.
- When you are in a zone where a Portal is very beneficial, like Sticks and Sheepie on the bottom portal entrance. You can place the grave, leave through that portal, reenter and the grave will be right there. 
**- HORDE SPAWN 2 platforms above and under your graveyard, this is based on order of height, not walking order.**

## **MAP Progression**
TLDR: Use following Image https://discord.com/channels/437797104786604034/1330702925294735360/1330703216069054484

- Mobs in order of strength. Higher Mobs drop more Bones
- **Active **= If a spot is active, the gravestone placement is relevant and will make a huge difference. You will manually place the gravestone each cooldown, either by re-entering the map through specific portal or gemshop for maximum efficiency. In some cases if you afk on an active map your gains may be terrible and worse than a lower afk map.
- **Afk **= If a spot is afk, the gravestone placement is not relevant as it will become random

**Other:** 
- In some rare scenarios (for active) it can be worth going out of your wraith form to stack the grave a little, only for ~10-50% of the buff duration (if even that long) then go back into wraith form. This is mostly for low dmg / high enemy hp areas, e.g. W5+. This goes hand in hand with Meta 2.
- If you place your grave on a skilling platform (not on all) such as brightsides tree or stalkers catching, the grave mobs only spawn on 1 platform making it extremely OP to trigger Detonations. This goes hand in hand with Meta 1, on a fresh grave, go out of wraith form, stack your grave a bit, then back into it and benefit from the large % bones multi.

**Basics:**
- There's a total of 20 levels to Ribbons
- You can merge 2 of the same rank for 1 higher rank ribbon. (2x T1 Ribbons = 1x T2,   2x T2 = 1x T3 Ribbon)
- If you have a ribbon on a meal, you can use the same one to +1 rank it
- If you have a ribbon on a meal, and you use a higher rank ribbon, you can upgrade that meal but lose the previous ribbon
- Stopwatch works (Gold and Silver) for daily ribbons
- Ribbon Storage has 28 space.

**Important**:
- **If your Ribbon Storage is full**, and you get a new ribbon, it will only merge if one of the ribbons in your storage is the same tier.
Example: (storage is 28)
- If you have a full storage of 28x t2 ribbons, and your daily rolls a t1 ribbon or a t3+ ribbon, you lose it.
- If you have a full storage of 28x t2 ribbons, and your daily rolls a t2 ribbon, you will have 27x T2 and 1x t3 ribbon.

**How to Unlock:** 
- By unlocking and purchasing "Ribbon Shelf", the 5th Upgrade on Grimoire.
- If you buy the Gembundle you also unlock it.

**Where is Ribbon Storage?** 
- At W4 at the Menu, click it.

**Where to get Ribbons?**
- +1 from Grimoire "Ribbon Winning"
- +5 from Gemshop Bundle
- +0 to +2 from DB Talent 10 "Ribbon Winning".  If you have 100% its 1 Ribbon, if you have 150% thats 1 ribbon and 50% chance for 2nd ribbon.

**What Ribbon Ranks to use?**
From the image beneath we can see the bonus each Rank gives, it displays the multi % gain from the previous rank. Some ranks are a terrible gain. Some of the rank increases are an 8-25% increase in benefit, but some are as low as 1-3%.
- **Best aim for 5's (Rank 5, 10, 15, 20)**
- Even Numbers are decent to stop on. 2, 4, 6, 8,...
- Uneven Numbers are bad, UNLESS it's the 5's, 3, 7, 9, 11, 13,...
Example:
- Going from Rank 1 to 2 is an 8% higher benefit, going to Rank 3 from 2 is only 4%.
- Better example, going from Rank 17 to 18 is a 7% gain, going to rank 19 from 18 is only a 1% gain, to 20 a 23% gain. (so upgrading to rank 19 is pretty bad)
- **TLDR**: This means, stop at good numbers. Make sure you try and get to the next breakpoint (bigger benefit)
